Yogesh Kumar Trivedi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt.
Of ... on 23 July, 2024 
Author: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
Bench: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:49540
Court No. - 4
Case :- Writ - A No. - 5560 of 2024
Petitioner :- Yogesh Kumar Trivedi
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Food Safety And Drug Administrat 
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sandeep Kumar Yadav,Abhay Pratap Yadav
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
1.  Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents. 
2. By means of this petition, the petitioner has assailed the impugned transfer order dated 30.6.2024 passed by the opposite party no.3 i.e., Additional Commissioner (Administration),
Department of Food Safety and Drug Administration, U.P., Lucknow transferring the petitioner from Balrampur to Sonbhadra in public interest. 
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has stated that Balrampur and Sonbhadra both are aspirational districts and the petitioner has completed 5 years' period at Balrampur, therefore, in terms of para 4 Yogesh Kumar Trivedi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 23 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189145712/
1 (iv) of the transfer policy, he had given option to the competent authority transferring him to any of the district namely, Lakhimpur Kheri, Barabanki or Unnao on 16.6.2024 (Annexure-3) but instead of transferring the petitioner pursuant to the option being submitted by him, he has been transferred to Sonbhadra, which is aspirational district.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has stated that the present petitioner has not been relieved from Balrampur as on today i.e., 23.7.2024. Hence, he has prayed that a direction may be issued to the opposite party no. 2 i.e., Commissioner, Department of Food Safety and Drug Administration,
U.P., Lucknow to decide the representation of the petitioner dated 2.7.2024 (Annexure-5).
5. Learned Standing Counsel has no objection if a direction for disposal of the aforesaid representation is issued. 
6. Therefore, without entering into merits of the issue,this writ petition is disposed of finally at the admission stage giving liberty to the petitioner to prefer a fresh representation to the opposite party no. 2 i.e., Commissioner, Department of Food Safety and Drug Administration, U.P., Lucknow taking all pleas and grounds which are available to him enclosing therewith copies of relevant documents and his earlier representations which are necessary for disposal of the representation,
within a period of 7 days from today and if such representation is preferred by the petitioner within aforesaid period, the authority concerned shall consider and dispose of the same strictly, by speaking and reasoned order in accordance with law, as per transfer policy also and also considering the option being given by the petitioner after affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner, if it is so required, with expedition preferably, within a period of 15 days from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and the decision thereof shall be intimated to the petitioner forthwith. 
7. Till the disposal of the aforesaid representation or a period of 20 days, whichever is earlier, the petitioner may not be relieved from Balrampur to Sonbhadra. However, the petitioner shall abide by the order being passed by the competent authority on his representation. 
Order Date :- 23.7.2024 Shravan [Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.]
